Fires on the token that completes a multi-token proper noun / compound name (the second piece of a name, brand, or hyphenated term), e.g. "-star" in "all-star", "HP" in "BHP", "ini" in "Panini", "as" in "Pittas", " Dollar" in "Taffi Dollar" — with the strongest negative values on the same structural slot in other names ("ham" in "Arkham", "MR" in "KSHMR", "ha" in "Ke$ha").

L3·N10486unmasked layer
Fires on medial/final sub-word fragments inside rare multi-token proper nouns and Latin/foreign words (e.g. " Domin" of "Dominus", "pire" of "Aspire", "ius" of "nullius"), i.e. it's a word-piece continuation detector rather than a semantic one; other name fragments ("ens", "ols", "czyn") strongly suppress it.
